protocol: The unchanged model is applied to the decoded URL path and GET/POST/JSON/cookie values, matching the PHP middleware input scope. SQLi CAPEC labels are positive; strictly normal rows are negative. Other attack families and conflicting labels are excluded. Model training and its 0.75 decision threshold did not use this capture. Runtime-hybrid metrics replay detector.php rules, immediate blocks, MLP screening of up to the first four non-immediately-blocked request values, and fail-safe blocking for gray-zone values after that budget. Previous gray-zone-only results are retained for comparison. The pre-screen policy was selected after diagnostic replay on this same capture, so hybrid metrics are development measurements rather than an untouched confirmation. The Python rule mirror is regression-tested against representative PHP signatures; this is not an end-to-end HTTP load test.

previous_gray_zone_only_policy.rules: security/detector.php SQLi signatures; maximum matching score is used
previous_gray_zone_only_policy.note: Replay of the PHP decision policy with an equivalent Python rule mirror; not an end-to-end HTTP load test.

runtime_hybrid_policy.mlp_values: first four request values also receive MLP screening below the current review threshold
runtime_hybrid_policy.budget_exceeded: scores in the existing 30..79 review zone fail-safe block; lower scores skip MLP
runtime_hybrid_policy.note: Replay of the current middleware decision policy with an equivalent Python rule mirror; not an end-to-end HTTP load test.
runtime_hybrid_policy.policy_selection_note: This first-four-value pre-screen policy was selected after diagnostic replay on the full capture; its reported metrics are development measurements, not an untouched post-selection confirmation. Model weights and the MLP 0.75 threshold were not tuned on this capture.
